subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence dry-run, retention window & term amendment proposal
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@acme-retail.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: acme-security-team@acme-retail.com
Date: 2027-03-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 recert + renewal: evidence handoff & retention ask

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the run-through last week. As we head into our annual renewal we need to re-attest SOC 2 with our auditors (scheduled for late April). A couple of asks from our security team: 

- Can Redwood run an evidence "dry run" the week of Mar 15 so we can validate formats and upload mechanics?
- We need audit logs retained for 18 months behind an archival access path for compliance. Can you confirm your retention window options?
- We will likely increase inference capacity for peak audit sampling (roughly 2x current committed throughput) — want to confirm short-term burst pricing and whether a 12 -> 24 month term would surface a better rate for the uplift.

I've attached our completed SOC 2 questionnaire (ACME_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.pdf) and a short list of sample logs we plan to provide. Please loop in whoever owns the evidence intake and pricing amendments.

Would appreciate a quick note with proposed dry-run steps and any blocker items.

Thanks,
Emma Liu
Head of Security Operations
Acme Retail


-----
Attachment: ACME_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert + renewal: evidence handoff & retention ask

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire. We can definitely run a dry run the week of Mar 15. Proposed plan below: 

1) Dry-run scope (Mar 15 - Mar 17): sample upload of 2 days of audit logs + 1 hour of trace-level request logs. We will ingest, validate formats, and run a mock evidence export for your auditors.

2) Intake options: SFTP (scoped access), secure Drive folder (shared link), or temporary S3 presigned upload. Marissa will own the upload path and will send explicit instructions.

3) Retention: Redwood supports a standard 12-month hot retention with affordable archive for 12-60 month windows. For an 18-month retention we propose 12 months hot + 6 months cold archive (archive access minutes-hours). I attached an updated checklist and a retention matrix that maps storage & unit-cost deltas.

4) Capacity & term: short answer — yes, we can support burst up to 2x for the audit window. From a commercial perspective, a 24-month term unlocks a lower per-token/seat rate; we can draft a 24-month amendment with a one-time seat uplift discount for the audit period. Draft T&C amendment attached for review.

Please confirm: (a) accept the dry-run window above, (b) which upload method you prefer, and (c) whether your procurement team wants the 24-month price option in the draft. I'll set up the intake instructions and a 30-minute dry-run kickoff once you confirm.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com


-----
Attachment: evidence_checklist_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Attachment: retention_matrix.csv (text/csv)
Attachment: redwood-term-amendment-24mo.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@acme-retail.com>, sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-12T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert + renewal: evidence dry-run details and upload path

Emma — looping in the ops side and giving visibility to Karthik on the commercial side. Technical notes and next steps: 

- Preferred upload: temporary S3 presigned uploads. We will create a per-tenant bucket with ingestion rules and a checksum validation step. If you prefer SFTP we can stand that up but it takes ~48 hours for creds and firewall rules.
- Dry-run deliverables: (a) successful ingestion of provided logs, (b) validation report (schema, missing fields, redaction flags), (c) mock auditor export (zip with manifest).
- Retention specifics: we can implement 18 months using a hot/cold profile. Cold archive retrieval for auditor pulls is subject to an archive-retrieval SLA (typically 1-4 hours). Cost delta captured in retention_matrix.csv.
- Burst capacity: we can provision a temporary dedicated pool for your audit week. Estimated uplift cost = monthly committed + one-time audit burst fee. Karthik — suggested commercial motion: 24-month term amendment with 15% credit on the incremental seats used for the audit month. I've attached a terse amendment PDF for review (redwood-term-amendment-24mo.pdf).

DocuSign link below to circulate the amendment once you confirm: https://docusign.com/tx/5F3A2B
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/record/RWD-ACME-2027-02

I will provision the S3 path tonight and share credentials with your security team (acme-security-team@acme-retail.com). If you want SFTP instead let me know by EOD 3/13.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Ops — Redwood Inference


-----
Attachment: retention_matrix.csv (text/csv)
Attachment: redwood-term-amendment-24mo.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme-retail.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: Emma Liu <emma.liu@acme-retail.com>, acme-security-team@acme-retail.com
Date: 2027-03-15T08:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert + renewal: evidence dry-run, retention window & term amendment proposal

Sofia / Marissa — thanks, this looks good. We confirm the dry-run window (Mar 15 - Mar 17) and prefer the S3 presigned uploads. Two quick asks before the kick-off: 

1) Can we get a brief 30-minute alignment call tomorrow (Mar 16) at 10:00 AM PT to walk through the checklist and responsibilities?
2) Please include the expected cost delta for the 24-month amendment vs the 12-month baseline in the DocuSign bundle so procurement can expedite.

I can share a small sample of logs to test credentials once you provision the S3 path.

Best,
Raj Patel
Sr. Manager, IT Compliance
Acme Retail

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 recert + renewal: evidence dry-run, retention window & term amendment proposal

Karthik — forwarding the thread. Dry-run completed successfully; Acme validated ingestion and we produced the mock export. They confirmed preference for 24-month term if we can include the seat-uplift credit Marissa outlined.

Action items for you: 
- Review the amendment (redwood-term-amendment-24mo.pdf) and confirm the 15% incremental-seat credit for the audit month.
- If green, please approve to send the DocuSign bundle to procurement (link in thread).

I'll hold on scheduling the procurement signature step until I get your sign-off.

Thanks,
Sofia
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
